gen-dafont-nordic-gf-sen: Ancient and hard-edged, Nordic spaces its letters like scattered brush dabs. Sen lifts its lowercase high and leaves its curves open, so the heading's cramped, closed shapes get a modern, breathing partner underneath.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-sintony: Sintony reads smooth and chunky, with curves that never clog and very little shift in stroke weight. Sintony and Nordic both keep their strokes plain, which gives the pair a rare, steady consistency despite the ancient heading.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans draws rounded letters with an open side and stencil-like lowercase that stands upright, with no stroke modulation. And Nordic, cramped and closed, is the sharpest foil for that openness, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-sono: Sono reads generously, with wide spacing and a lowercase that towers over its capitals. Nordic's cramped, closed letters sit above it like carved stone over an open doorway, ancient and tight against all that room.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-stack-sans-headline: Blunt and ancient, Nordic carves its letters with a single unchanging stroke. But Stack Sans Headline is the real surprise, a plain sans whose wide gaps and deep middle band feel open where Nordic is closed.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-stack-sans-notch: Nordic crowds its openings shut like a pressed leaf fold, with brush-dab spacing between the letters. Stack Sans Notch answers it by letting its curves open wide, and that closed-against-open split is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-tiktok-sans: Ancient meets modern here, with Nordic's cramped, powerful letters up top. TikTok Sans brings a lowercase that climbs nearly to cap height and a spacious c, making the strongest quality the closed-versus-open split.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-amiko: Stretched wide and technical, Nulshock lays out its outlined capitals with generous tracking. Amiko's chunky lowercase and outward-flaring terminals keep a long passage moving easily.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-anek-devanagari: Technical in spirit, Nulshock spreads its outlined letters wide at one steady stroke width. And Anek Devanagari keeps its mouths distinctly open and its middle zone high, so a longer passage reads smoothly and without strain.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Wide, outlined and bold, Nulshock skims along on a stroke that never changes weight. And Anek Gurmukhi follows with big open counters and generous curves, so the sturdy heading hands off to something far more relaxed.
